channel.title: Proof of Problem Protocol (PoPP) Blog
channel.description: Latest news, insights, and technical updates from the PoPP protocol team and community.

item.title: Why Decentralized Problem Verification Matters
item.description: Current complaint systems let problems vanish into bureaucracy. PoPP changes that by making every problem cryptographically provable and auditable.

item.title: Understanding the Validator Role in PoPP
item.description: Validators are the backbone of PoPP. Learn how they stake tokens, review evidence, and earn rewards for accurate problem validation.

item.title: From Complaint to Protocol: The Origin of PoPP
item.description: How a broken internet line and repeated unanswered complaints led to the creation of a decentralized truth verification protocol.

item.title: How PoPP Integrates with Cosmos SDK
item.description: A technical deep-dive into how PoPP leverages the Cosmos SDK for its Layer-3 blockchain, including ticket submissions and on-chain proofs.

item.title: DAO Governance: Shaping PoPP Together
item.description: PoPP is community-governed. Learn how proposals are submitted, discussed, and voted on by token holders in the PoPP DAO.

item.title: Civic Tech and PoPP: Real-World Impact
item.description: From water contamination reports to infrastructure hazards — how communities are using PoPP to turn verified problems into action.
